title: QUOTIENT ( -5, 2 ) is -2: the integer portion of -2.5

source.quote: Performs division and returns only the integer portion of the division result.
source.supports: the integer portion of the result is returned

derivation: -5 / 2 = -2.5. Its integer portion (the remainder discarded) is -2.
alternative: If QUOTIENT rounds down like INT, the result is -3. The pages give no example with a negative argument.
